journey.name: wear restore passphrase
journey.description:
The test phrase restored with a passphrase opens a different wallet: Home shows 0 where the same phrase without a passphrase shows the test wallet's balance (wear restore 12 words). Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app. Backend: hosted regtest; the passphrase wallet is empty, so its first sync takes seconds. The passphrase screen blocks screenshots, so check it with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Type the test phrase (README › Typing several words)
Verify the title (tag "RestorePassphraseTitle") reads "Passphrase?", then tap the key button (tag "RestorePassphraseAdd")
Verify the passphrase field (tag "RestorePassphraseInput") is empty with the placeholder text "Passphrase", and Restore (tag "RestorePassphraseConfirm") is visible
Type `watchtest` into "RestorePassphraseInput" (README › Typing: tap the field, Back, then the text; no Enter)
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it lists "WatchHomeBalance", for up to 2 minutes
